title: Honey pork meatballs
ingredients: One large carrot cut into half moons
One zuchini cut into half moons
Cut potatoes, put in pot with 2 tsp salt just covering potatoes and boil 10-12 mins til fork tender.
Sauteed carrot in 1 tbsp butter with 1/4 cup water 2-3 mins
Sauteed zucchini 4-5 mins in same pan
Mash potatoes with garlic, parsley, 1 tsp hutter, 1/4 cup cream
instructions: Mix pork with breadcrumbs, add 1/4 tsp salt, some pepper. Form into 12 meatballs and roast 450 turning once for 10-12 mins til cooked.
Mix chicken broth concentrate, 1/3 cup water, Dijon, honey in pot, whisk to combine
